name: comprehensive-performance-optimization
title: 全面性能优化与必要重写
description: Measure and eliminate Mica's UI, state-publication, projection, networking, persistence, and concurrency bottlenecks; permit evidence-backed rewrites and mature third-party dependencies only when they materially improve performance or correctness.
creator: mica
notes: Completed the offline performance rebuild: actor-owned live ingestion and immutable publications, generation-scoped refresh coordination, narrow page projections and visibility demand, indexed/cancellable topology work, split Workbench data pages, cached storage/localization formatting, privacy-safe signposts, deterministic benchmarks, documentation/spec updates, and concentrated build/test/source/HIG validation. No third-party package was retained because the measured swift-protobuf traits experiment was not material. Real-controller Instruments and runtime smoke remain intentionally deferred by user instruction.
